description: This file defines the SugarCacheZend class, which is an implementation of a caching backend using Zend shared memory cache for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It extends the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class and provides methods to use, set, get, clear, and reset external cache data via Zend's shared memory functions.

classes.name: SugarCacheZend
classes.description: A cache implementation using Zend shared memory cache, extending the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class and providing specific caching operations.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the Zend shared memory cache backend should be used based on function existence and configuration.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a serialized value in Zend shared memory cache associated with a key.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes a value from Zend shared memory cache for a given key.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry for a given key from Zend shared memory cache.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears all entries from Zend shared memory cache.
